mcqs.question: According to the National Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation (NOTTO), how did the number of organ transplants in India change between 2013 and 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Organ transplants increased from fewer than 5,000 in 2013 to approximately 20,000 in 2025, according to NOTTO data. The figures 9.08 lakh and 6.26 lakh refer to Indian students abroad, while 22.68 lakh and 28.15 lakh refer to cyber crime cases.
